Dailies

Welcome. Here’s the 30-second tour.

A home for every reference you don’t want to lose, and the quickest way to find it again.

  1. Save anything.Press Save and paste a link, a note or an image. With the Chrome extension, one click saves the page you’re on.
  2. Find it again.Search for what you remember. Categories groups everything by hashtag, and Sort puts it in the order you want.
  3. Start a project.One per piece of work, with a short brief. Use Add to project on any card to send references to it.
  4. Lay it out on its canvas.Every project has a canvas inside it. Press Add references, tick a few and press Done: they land as a collage, ready to arrange.

All of this lives in Settings, under Help.

Bring in your notes

Text (.txt), Markdown (.md), HTML, Evernote (.enex), Google Keep (.json) or a .zip of any of these. Headings, lists, checklists, links and pictures come along, and each note keeps its original date.

or drop files or a folder here

Where do I get these files?
  • Apple Notes: Notes has no “export all”. On a Mac, get the free Exporter app from the Mac App Store, export your notes as Markdown, then choose that folder here. For a single note, copy it in Notes and paste it into a new note here.
  • Notion: ••• → Export → Markdown & CSV, then choose the .zip.
  • Google Keep: takeout.google.com → Keep, then choose the Keep folder.
  • Evernote: select notes → Export → .enex.
  • Obsidian, Bear, iA Writer: choose the folder or the .md files.
